from pathlib import Path
p=Path('/workspace/candidate_trace.json')
trace=[
  {"step":1,"file":"test/hoedown_fuzzer.c","function":"LLVMFuzzerTestOneInput","line":64,"var":"ib->data","code":"hoedown_buffer_put(ib, data, size);","note":"The attacker-controlled fuzz input is copied into the Markdown input buffer unchanged."},
  {"step":2,"file":"src/document.c","function":"char_link","line":1188,"var":"data","code":"if (size < 2 || data[1] != '[') return 0;","note":"A leading '!' routes parsing into the image/link handler when the next byte is '['."},
  {"step":3,"file":"src/document.c","function":"char_link","line":1200,"var":"txt_e","code":"i += find_emph_char(data + i, size - i, ']'); txt_e = i;","note":"The parser scans attacker-controlled bytes to locate the closing bracket that ends the link text."},
  {"step":4,"file":"src/document.c","function":"char_link","line":1218,"var":"link_b/link_e","code":"while (i < size && _isspace(data[i])) i++; if (i < size && data[i] == '(') { ... link_b = i; ... while (i < size) { ... }","note":"After the bracketed text, the parser consumes the destination inside parentheses and records its bounds from the same input."},
  {"step":5,"file":"src/document.c","function":"char_link","line":1248,"var":"link","code":"link = hoedown_buffer_new(...); hoedown_buffer_put(link, data + link_b, link_e - link_b);","note":"The extracted destination bytes are copied into a heap buffer that becomes the image/link URL value."},
  {"step":6,"file":"src/html.c","function":"rndr_autolink","line":191,"var":"link->data","code":"HOEDOWN_BUFPUTSL(ob, \"<a href=\\\"\"); ... escape_href(ob, link->data, link->size);","note":"The renderer later walks the URL bytes to escape them for HTML output; the crash hypothesis is that a malformed destination can drive an out-of-bounds read in this escaping path."}
]
p.write_text(__import__('json').dumps(trace, indent=2))
print(p)
